forensic_question: What can accessible Git actually prove about the transition from post-effect logging to the current Phase-2 PreToolUse bookkeeping plus PostToolUse verification design?

semantic_atoms.claim: Immediately before the first shipped plugin payload, the repository explicitly says the actual harness, including hooks and effect journal, runs locally outside the repository. The scripts/stern.py path is absent at this commit.
semantic_atoms.implication: The true mechanism introduction predates source visibility in this repository. A Git commit timestamp after this point must not be presented as the invention date of the effect journal or Phase-2 mechanism.

semantic_atoms.claim: Commit b0be33f is the first verified accessible-Git commit on the shipped scripts/stern.py path. Its source already contains the Phase-2 EFFECTGATE section, including PreToolUse zulassen(), PostToolUse verification through merken(), a mutable active_turns.effect_id session slot, and the explicit invariant that ordinary zulassen() never blocks tool execution.
semantic_atoms.failure_boundary: Because the parent repository did not contain the host source, this commit proves packaging/source publication, not when the mechanism was first built on the host.

semantic_atoms.claim: Commit 4901b89 explicitly resynchronizes a substantially larger live ~/.claude/star/stern.py into the repository after host-side PHASE 9-24 work. This is a provenance/mirror boundary. This delta does not infer which effect semantics changed inside that interval without line-level comparison.

The three-layer repository reorganization moves the canonical research copy of stern.py under DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/. Path movement is provenance continuity, not evidence of a new effect architecture.

At the current pinned donor, ordinary PreToolUse still calls nonblocking zulassen(), PostToolUse calls merken(), and a separate SEBUKKU branch is the explicit local deny-capable branch. The current effect bookkeeping therefore must not be credited as the canonical blocking effect authority.

chronology_result.first_verified_accessible_git_source_sna: first shipped/source-visible snapshot containing the Phase-2 effect design

contradictions.claim_a: Current stern.py comments describe a transition from a prior post-effect-only journal to Phase-2 PreToolUse bookkeeping plus verification.
contradictions.claim_b: The repository parent before b0be33f states the effect journal is already live outside the repo, while the implementation source itself is absent there.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Report b0be33f only as first verified accessible-Git source snapshot. Do not claim it is the mechanism's creation commit. Recover host-side history/archived source for a stronger date claim.

frankenstein_2_0_delta.lineage_rule: Triggerword-4 documentation must distinguish FIRST_VERIFIED_IN_ACCESSIBLE_GIT from CREATED/INTRODUCED_ON_DATE.
frankenstein_2_0_delta.effect_rule: Do not inherit the historical name EffectGate as authority semantics. Frankenstein-2.0 requires typed ADMISSION_DECISION -> ENFORCEMENT_DECISION -> EXECUTION_RECEIPT -> WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION -> RESULT_REENTRY/COMPLETION with immutable per-invocation identity.
frankenstein_2_0_delta.migration_rule: Path reorganizations and live-to-repo mirror refreshes preserve provenance but do not by themselves prove behavior changes.

next_exact_gate: Acquire host-side archived stern.py/wache-koenig history if available to resolve the real pre-Phase2 -> Phase-2 transition; otherwise preserve UNRESOLVED_HOST_ONLY_PREHISTORY and stop assigning invention dates from packaging commits. Independently continue the current Triggerword-4 invocation-bound typed effect contract.
